title: Pierre Robiglio
text:
I am an Economist at the Chief Economist Team of DG COMP, European Commission. I hold a PhD in Economics from the Rome Economics Doctorate (RED), a program jointly run by EIEF, LUISS, Sapienza University of Rome and Tor Vergata University of Rome.


I work across competition instruments, with a focus on digital markets and energy.


My PhD supervisors were Matteo Paradisi and Emilio Calvano.
